requirements.quote:
Parts of QUIC packet headers, in particular the Packet Number field,
   are protected using a key that is derived separately from the packet
   protection key and IV.
requirements.condition: When deriving the key used for QUIC header protection.
requirements.required_behavior: Derive the header-protection key separately from the packet-protection key and IV.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use the packet-protection key or IV directly as the header-protection key.
requirements.why_checkable: Key-schedule instrumentation or known-answer vectors can verify that header protection uses a separately labeled derivation output.

requirements.quote:
The key derived using the "quic hp" label is
   used to provide confidentiality protection for those fields that are
   not exposed to on-path elements.
requirements.condition: When applying confidentiality protection to non-exposed QUIC header fields.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the key derived with the "quic hp" label.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a key derived with a different label for QUIC header protection.
requirements.why_checkable: A known header-protection vector can verify that the mask is produced with the key derived from the exact "quic hp" label.

requirements.quote:
This protection applies to the least significant bits of the first
   byte, plus the Packet Number field.
requirements.condition: For a QUIC packet type to which header protection applies.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to the Packet Number field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the Packet Number field unprotected.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized packet number bytes can be compared before and after application of the header-protection mask.

requirements.quote:
The four least significant bits
   of the first byte are protected for packets with long headers;
requirements.condition: For a packet with a long header to which header protection applies.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to exactly the four least significant bits of the first byte.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply the first-byte header-protection mask outside those four least significant bits.
requirements.why_checkable: Known unprotected and protected header bytes can be XOR-compared to verify the four-bit mask boundary.

requirements.quote:
the
   five least significant bits of the first byte are protected for
   packets with short headers.
requirements.condition: For a packet with a short header to which header protection applies.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to exactly the five least significant bits of the first byte.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply the first-byte header-protection mask outside those five least significant bits.
requirements.why_checkable: Known unprotected and protected header bytes can be XOR-compared to verify the five-bit mask boundary.

requirements.quote:
For both header forms, this covers the
   reserved bits and the Packet Number Length field; the Key Phase bit
   is also protected for packets with a short header.
requirements.condition: For either a protected long-header or short-header packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to the reserved bits.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not expose the reserved bits without header protection.
requirements.why_checkable: The reserved-bit positions can be checked for application of the first-byte protection mask in both header forms.

requirements.quote:
For both header forms, this covers the
   reserved bits and the Packet Number Length field; the Key Phase bit
   is also protected for packets with a short header.
requirements.condition: For either a protected long-header or short-header packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to the Packet Number Length field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not expose the Packet Number Length field without header protection.
requirements.why_checkable: The Packet Number Length bit positions can be checked for application of the first-byte protection mask in both header forms.

requirements.quote:
For both header forms, this covers the
   reserved bits and the Packet Number Length field; the Key Phase bit
   is also protected for packets with a short header.
requirements.condition: For a protected packet with a short header.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply header protection to the Key Phase bit.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not expose the Key Phase bit without header protection.
requirements.why_checkable: The Key Phase bit position can be checked for application of the short-header first-byte protection mask.

requirements.quote:
The same header protection key is used for the duration of the
   connection, with the value not changing after a key update (see
   Section 6).
requirements.condition: Throughout a connection, including after packet-protection key updates.
requirements.required_behavior: Continue using the same header-protection key value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not change the header-protection key as part of a key update.
requirements.why_checkable: Header-protection key values can be captured before and after key updates and compared for equality over the connection lifetime.

requirements.quote:
This process does not apply to Retry or Version Negotiation packets,
   which do not contain a protected payload or any of the fields that
   are protected by this process.
requirements.condition: When serializing or parsing a Retry packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Leave the Retry packet outside the header-protection process.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply QUIC header protection to a Retry packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A Retry packet can be serialized and compared with its defined fields to verify that no header-protection mask is applied.

requirements.quote:
This process does not apply to Retry or Version Negotiation packets,
   which do not contain a protected payload or any of the fields that
   are protected by this process.
requirements.condition: When serializing or parsing a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Leave the Version Negotiation packet outside the header-protection process.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply QUIC header protection to a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A Version Negotiation packet can be serialized and compared with its defined fields to verify that no header-protection mask is applied.
